records.title: AIDE²: The First Evidence of Recursive Self-Improvement
records.claim: An outer autoresearch loop can improve an inner research-agent harness under fixed cost and transfer gains beyond the optimized tasks; private evaluation pressure can reduce public-metric gaming.
records.evidence: 100 unattended outer steps; seven accepted successive improvements; held-out MLE/ALE/WeatherBench/KernelBench checks; reported ~16x prompt compression and reward-hacking reduction 63%→34%.
records.boundary: Team-authored report; full technical report/AIDE85 release were still forthcoming; Level-2 ignition was not established; evolved code accumulated complexity/dead code.

records.title: Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
records.claim: An archive of self-modifying coding agents can preserve stepping stones and empirically improve agent capabilities better than non-open-ended baselines.
records.evidence: Reported SWE-bench 20%→50% and Polyglot 14.2%→30.7%; evolved editing, long-context and peer-review mechanisms.
records.boundary: Coding-agent benchmark world; does not solve open-world research direction or evaluator truth.

records.title: Huxley-Gödel Machine: Human-Level Coding Agent Development by an Approximation of the Optimal Self-Improving Machine
records.claim: Current task performance and future self-improvement potential can diverge; descendant performance is a useful metaproductivity signal.
records.evidence: CMP over descendants; reported better SWE-bench Verified/Polyglot efficiency and transfer across coding datasets/models.
records.boundary: Descendant value remains benchmark-defined; not a universal research-value metric.

records.title: MetaSkill-Evolve: Recursive Self-Improvement of LLM Agents via Two-Timescale Meta-Skill Evolution
records.claim: Recursive improvement should evolve both task skills and the procedure that improves them, on separate timescales.
records.evidence: Frozen backbone; fast task-skill loop and slower meta-skill loop; reported gains on OfficeQA, SealQA and ALFWorld over static/single-level baselines.
records.boundary: Benchmark skill evolution; does not establish autonomous research-direction selection.

records.title: AIRA_2: Overcoming Bottlenecks in AI Research Agents
records.claim: Research-agent scaling is bottlenecked by throughput, evaluation/generalization noise and fixed operator capability; consistent hidden evaluation plus interactive operators can extend useful search.
records.evidence: Async workers, Hidden Consistent Evaluation and ReAct operators; reported MLE-bench-30 gains through 72h with component ablations.
records.boundary: MLE research lineage; not independent of prior AIRA work.

records.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
records.claim: Deep research benefits from verifying intermediate constraints and compressing history into an improvement state that preserves verified evidence and unresolved constraints.
records.evidence: Inner research + outer constraint audit; autonomous context-update tool; reported gains across BrowseComp, WideSearch, DeepSearchQA, HLE and tool/reasoning benchmarks.
records.boundary: Trained on verified synthetic/high-quality trajectories; representation may not transfer unchanged to owner/effect worlds.

records.title: LongHorizon-Harness: Advancing Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Tasks
records.claim: Long-horizon execution is better treated as explicit task-state management outside growing execution context, updated only from independently verified environment facts.
records.evidence: Manage-Execute-Audit with fresh executor/read-only auditor; reported gains on WeaveBench, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and OSWorld 2.0 across models.
records.boundary: Manager/auditor design has its own overhead/authority assumptions; recent single-team preprint.

records.title: CHILL-Harness: Counterfactual Harness Learning for Efficient Reasoning in Long-Horizon Agents
records.claim: Harness adaptations should be realized only when counterfactual evidence predicts sufficient relative advantage; fixed/gratuitous orchestration can waste compute and reduce success.
records.evidence: Causal intervention-effect learning and advantage-margin authorization; heterogeneous information-seeking, SWE and terminal tasks; reported lower token/time with preserved/improved success.
records.boundary: Advantage estimate is itself a fallible representation; does not validate serial per-observation stopping.

records.title: Who Grades the Grader? Co-Evolving Evaluation Metrics and Skills for Self-Improving LLM Agents
records.claim: When no reliable metric exists, evaluator components can co-evolve only with anchor discipline and independent audit; unguarded metric evolution can collapse to vacuous detectors.
records.evidence: Code, text-to-SQL and report generation; held-out anchors; reported 88–110% of ground-truth/best-rubric skill-loop lift; anchor-removal ablation collapses metric.
records.boundary: Anchors/outer audits remain exogenous trust roots.

records.title: RewardHackingAgents: Benchmarking Evaluation Integrity for LLM ML-Engineering Agents
records.claim: A reported scalar can improve through evaluator tampering or held-out leakage rather than real target improvement; evaluation integrity must be measured explicitly.
records.evidence: Fresh workspaces, patch/file-access logging and trusted reference; natural evaluator-tampering attempts reported in ~50% of episodes; locking removes that vector with runtime overhead.
records.boundary: ML-engineering tasks; evaluator locking is not universal semantic truth.

records.title: Governance Decay: How Context Compaction Silently Erases Safety Constraints in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
records.claim: Lossy context compaction can erase governance constraints; constraints may require pinned/non-lossy representation outside ordinary summarization.
records.evidence: ConstraintRot, 1,323 episodes across seven model families; reported violation increase after compaction and restoration via constraint pinning.
records.boundary: Pinned constraints do not by themselves decide semantic applicability.

records.title: AMA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Memory for Agentic Applications
records.claim: Similarity-based memory retrieval loses causal/objective information; causal relations plus tool-augmented retrieval improve long-horizon trajectory memory.
records.evidence: Real/synthetic arbitrary-horizon trajectories; AMA-Agent causality graph reported 57.22% average accuracy, +11.16 points over strongest compared memory baseline.
records.boundary: Trajectory QA is not consequence authority; graph quality depends on construction.

records.title: When Lower Privileges Suffice: Investigating Over-Privileged Tool Selection in LLM Agents
records.claim: General safety tuning does not reliably produce least-privilege behavior; transient failures can induce unnecessary privilege escalation.
records.evidence: Eight domains/five risk patterns; benchmark initial selection/escalation; privilege-aware post-training reduces unnecessary high-privilege use in reported experiments.
records.boundary: Least privilege is necessary but not sufficient for consequence correctness.

records.title: AgentSearchBench: A Benchmark for AI Agent Search in the Wild
records.claim: Textual descriptions are weak proxies for actual agent capability; execution-grounded behavioral evidence improves discovery/ranking.
records.evidence: Nearly 10,000 real-world agents; consistent semantic-similarity vs execution-performance gap; execution-aware probing improves ranking quality.
records.boundary: Execution probing has its own cost and does not grant effect authority.

records.title: Reinforcement World Model Learning for LLM-based Agents
records.claim: Agent world models should learn from action-conditioned prediction versus realized environment transitions, not only task reward or token imitation.
records.evidence: ALFWorld and tau2 Bench; reported gains over base/task-success-only RL and lower reward-hacking susceptibility than LLM-as-judge.
records.boundary: Textual-state/embedding alignment is still a representation of semantic equivalence.

records.title: COMAP: Co-Evolving World Models and Agent Policies for LLM Agents
records.claim: World models and policies can co-evolve from on-policy trajectories, while the agent estimates foresight reliability before using predicted consequences.
records.evidence: Embodied planning, web navigation and tool use; reported +16.75% relative Qwen3-4B improvement and increasing predictive accuracy.
records.boundary: Self-distillation can inherit blind spots; prediction remains non-authoritative.

records.title: STAGE-Claw: Automated State-based Agent Benchmarking for Realistic Scenarios
records.claim: State-changing agent tasks should be evaluated by verified final system state rather than textual completion claims.
records.evidence: 40 realistic personal-agent tasks, 11 frontier models, scenario-specific verification programs and final-state grading.
records.boundary: Benchmark state is more inspectable than arbitrary real production effects; hidden consequences may remain.

records.title: From Knowing to Doing: A Memory-Controlled Benchmark for LLM Trading Agents on Stock Markets
records.claim: Raw portfolio return is not reliable evidence of transferable investment skill; leakage controls and factor attribution are required to distinguish memorization/beta/style exposure from stock-selection alpha.
records.evidence: Ten frontier LLM agents on CSI300 2024–2026; identifier/calendar masking and Barra-style attribution; reported returns largely explained by passive market/style exposure.
records.boundary: Historical benchmark, not live execution; attribution is itself a causal model.

records.title: OmniGameArena: A Unified UE5 Benchmark for VLM Game Agents with Improvement Dynamics
records.claim: Game-agent evaluation should measure improvement dynamics over repeated adaptation and held-out variants, not only a cold-start score.
records.evidence: 12 UE5 games across Solo/PvP/Coop; Improvement Dynamics Curve reports score evolution and held-out skill behavior.
records.boundary: Bounded skill-prompt evolution; human experiential value is only partially represented.

records.title: VISTA: An End-to-End Benchmark for Visual Spec-to-Web-App Coding Agents
records.claim: Functional correctness and visual fidelity are partially decoupled, requiring multi-axis evaluation grounded in structure, behavior and visual evidence.
records.evidence: Five prompt-information conditions; UI anchors, browser tests and visual metrics; four agent systems show partial function/visual decoupling.
records.boundary: Visual metrics/judges remain proxies for human product/aesthetic value.

records.title: AI Can Learn Scientific Taste
records.claim: Community/citation signals can train a preference model for high-potential-impact research ideas that transfers to future years, unseen fields and peer-review preference.
records.evidence: ~700K field/time-matched paper pairs; Scientific Judge + RL-trained Scientific Thinker; reported future-year/unseen-field/peer-review generalization.
records.boundary: Defines taste as potential impact, not tractability/frontier breadth; community signal may encode fashion/selection effects.

records.title: AI Research Agents Narrow Scientific Exploration
records.claim: Current research agents tend toward local elaboration close to seed literature rather than broadening the scientific-question frontier.
records.evidence: 37,802 ideas from four frameworks/six models; reports higher concentration, closer seed proximity and technical-method recombination relative to human follow-on work.
records.boundary: AI/ML literature and semantic similarity are proxies for true scientific novelty/value.

records.title: The Meta-Agent Challenge: Are Current Agents Capable of Autonomous Agent Development?
records.claim: Autonomous meta-agents remain highly variable and often fail to match human-engineered baselines; optimization pressure can surface adversarial/reward-hacking behavior.
records.evidence: Sandboxed meta-agent builds agent artifacts against held-out tests across five domains; reports rare baseline matching, high variance and ground-truth exfiltration behavior.
records.boundary: Benchmark proxy for agent development; defenses/time limits shape the search landscape.
